project.title: Unified Customer Support Portal and Knowledge Base
project.objective: Design and implement a unified web portal and knowledge base to streamline customer support workflows and reduce call handling time.
deliverables: Requirements and UX specification for the support portal
Responsive web portal for customers and agents
Integrated searchable knowledge base with role-based access
Call centre workflows and scripts aligned with the portal
Security and compliance checklist for the new platform
constraints: Must integrate with existing ticketing and telephony systems via APIs only
Comply with ICT security legislation and internal security guidelines
Initial MVP must be ready for pilot within 21 days
Portal must support modern browsers and mobile devices
Knowledge base content must be maintainable by non-technical staff

risks.risk: Integration with legacy ticketing and telephony systems takes longer than expected.
risks.mitigation: Define minimal integration scope for MVP and stub non-critical endpoints.

risks.risk: Call centre agents do not adopt the new portal and keep using old tools.
risks.mitigation: Involve agents in requirements, run pilot training, and collect feedback for quick iterations.

risks.risk: Security review identifies non-compliance close to launch.
risks.mitigation: Apply security checklist from the start and schedule early security review on prototype.

risks.risk: Knowledge base content becomes outdated quickly after launch.
risks.mitigation: Define ownership, review cadence, and simple content update workflow for support staff.

themes.why_relevant: Keeps the team focused on what must be in the first pilot vs later iterations.
Portal must work with current ticketing and telephony without major rewrites.
Call centre agents need fast, intuitive flows to reduce handling time.
Portal handles customer data and must comply with ICT security legislation.
Content must be easy to search, maintain, and keep up to date.

backlog.task: Gather and document requirements from call centre for the unified support portal
definition_of_done: List of current pain points and desired features captured
Top 10 call types and workflows documented
Requirements doc reviewed by at least one software developer and one web developer

backlog.task: Design information architecture and navigation for the customer-facing portal
definition_of_done: Site map and main navigation flows defined
Wireframes for key pages shared with team
Call centre agent confirms flows cover top call types

backlog.task: Implement MVP backend services for ticket search and creation
definition_of_done: API endpoints for ticket search and creation implemented
Endpoints integrated with existing ticketing system sandbox
Basic error handling and logging in place
Unit tests cover main flows

backlog.task: Build responsive front-end for agent dashboard
definition_of_done: Dashboard shows ticket list, customer details, and knowledge base suggestions
Layout works on desktop and tablet screen sizes
Connected to MVP backend services
Accessibility basics checked (keyboard navigation, contrast)

backlog.task: Define and document standard call handling scripts aligned with the portal
definition_of_done: Scripts for top 10 call types drafted
Scripts reference specific portal pages and flows
Reviewed by at least one software developer for feasibility

backlog.task: Set up knowledge base data model and search functionality
definition_of_done: Data model for articles, categories, and tags implemented
Search API with relevance ranking available
Performance acceptable for typical query load in test environment

backlog.task: Implement knowledge base management UI for support staff
definition_of_done: UI allows create, edit, publish, and archive of articles
Role-based access enforced for editors vs viewers
Call centre agent validates usability with sample content

backlog.task: Create security and compliance checklist for the support portal
definition_of_done: Checklist covers authentication, authorisation, logging, and data protection
Aligned with ICT security legislation references
Reviewed with internal security contact

backlog.task: Prepare pilot training plan and quick-start guide for agents
definition_of_done: Training agenda and objectives defined
Quick-start guide with screenshots drafted
Pilot group of agents identified and informed

backlog.task: Set up staging environment and deployment pipeline for the portal
definition_of_done: Staging environment accessible to team
Automated build and deploy pipeline configured
Basic rollback procedure documented

backlog.task: Implement customer self-service portal pages for FAQs and ticket status
definition_of_done: FAQ page connected to knowledge base
Ticket status page integrated with ticketing system
Mobile responsiveness verified
Content placeholders ready for go-live

backlog.task: Run pilot feedback collection and prioritise improvements
definition_of_done: Feedback from pilot agents collected via survey or interviews
Top 5 improvement items identified
Improvement list shared with developers and agreed for next iteration

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on MVP scope, key workflows, and initial backlog for the support portal.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and asking for MVP scope proposals.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the list of core MVP features for the portal and knowledge base.
Confirm ownership and deadlines for tasks T1-T4 in the initial sprint.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in information architecture, UX flows, and agent scripts.
threads_plan.trigger: Web developer shares first draft of site map and wireframes for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial information architecture and main navigation flows.
Agree on the final list of standard call scripts to prepare for pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Resolve technical integration and security approach for MVP.
threads_plan.trigger: Software developer posts update on API integration progress and open questions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose which ticketing and telephony integrations are in scope for MVP.
Approve the security checklist as the baseline for go-live readiness.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prepare and confirm the pilot plan, training, and feedback loop.
threads_plan.trigger: Call centre agent shares draft training plan and asks for pilot timeline confirmation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot start date and participating agent group.
Agree on how pilot feedback will be collected and prioritised.

channel_rituals: Daily async standup where each role posts yesterday/today/blockers in one thread.
Twice-weekly MVP scope check to confirm priorities and adjust backlog.
Weekly integration and security review update with open risks and mitigations.
Post-pilot retrospective thread to capture learnings and next-iteration priorities.
